alert.message: OpenClaw gateway status is inconsistent: RPC probe is OK and 127.0.0.1:18789 is listening, but 'openclaw gateway status' reports runtime stopped/inactive with a non-standard outdated systemd service config embedding a gateway token. PM2 also shows 'openclaw-gateway' online with 2995 restarts.
alert.action: Audit the active gateway supervisor path (PM2 vs systemd), inspect restart cause, and reinstall the systemd unit with 'openclaw gateway install --force' only after confirming the intended deployment mode.
